executiveSummary: Today's AI picture is being shaped by open-source stack, model platforms, governance and controls. The strongest signals point to a market where research progress, platform controls, and workflow execution are converging into more operational buying criteria.
strategicTakeaways: The open-source layer is turning into a strategic option set for AI stack design, not only a hobbyist ecosystem.
Vendor differentiation is moving from model access to operational trust, controls, and ecosystem depth.
Governance is moving from compliance overlay to product requirement for deployable AI.
